https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/getting-started-thunderbird-pro https://thundermail.com/

Thundermail is an email service while Thunderbird is a email client where you can do things such as manage multiple email accounts (via IMAP or POP3) which can include Thundermail. Thundermail is email hosting with custom domain support and aliases.

So no, Thundermail will not replace the Thunderbird email client.
